1.explanation:
1. src/upload/list.jsx: In getPictureCardList, when itemRender is a function, it replaces the entire card body and never renders the close (delete) icon. This is the core of the bug.  
2. src/upload/card.jsx: The Card component always passes a truthy 'closable' prop and forwards itemRender down to List, so understanding how itemRender flows through Card is necessary to fix the prop handling.  
3. src/upload/upload.jsx: This file defines the Upload API and passes props such as itemRender and listType into List. If the default behavior needs to be preserved even when itemRender is supplied, the merging logic here may require adjustment to combine custom content with default actions.
1.bug_scenario: In the custom image‐card mode (listType="image" or "card") shown in the screenshot, the developer has provided an itemRender function that draws an overlay with a timestamp. As a result, the built-in delete (close) icon no longer appears and users cannot remove the file. In other words, supplying itemRender completely overrides the widget’s default delete UI.
